name: pirouline.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.
lesson: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.
summary: pirouline.com scores 74 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 30 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 50 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 50 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 152 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 27 elements on /, /about-us/, /our-wafer-cookies/, for example .cookie-statement.cmplz-link[data-relative_url=""] and a[href$="pirouline.com"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: 50 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /about-us/, /our-wafer-cookies/, /our-wafer-cookies/chocolate-hazelnut-creme-filled-wafers/ and 46 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 50 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
The start page declares its language
The largest element paints in 1.7 s
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
